Name: Evelyn's Fireside Tales
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][color=#c27ba0][size=6][b][u]Evelyn’s Fireside Tales[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[i][size=4]A warm fire, a cup of tea, and somewhere familiar to visit every Friday afternoon.[/size][/i][/center]
[center]********************************************************************[/center]
[center][/center]
[size=4]Once the Community Center has been restored, Evelyn begins a new Pelican Town tradition.
Every Friday afternoon, neighbors gather beside the fireplace while Evelyn reads the next chapter from her collection of fantasy adventures, unsettling ghost stories, strange journeys among the stars, and hard boiled detective mysteries. Come in from the weather, find a place by the fire, and stay for a story and a hot cup of tea. [/size]

[size=4][b]**[/b][i][b]This mod was inspired by my granny who would sit me down with a cup of tea and tell me stories at night. This mod is for anyone needing that special granny energy that we all need in some form or another. Love you granny.**[/b][/i][/size]
[size=4] [/size]
[size=5][b]A New Friday Tradition[/b][/size]
[size=4]Each season features one complete original story told across four weekly reading events:[/size]

[size=4]Friday 5: Chapter One
Friday 12: Chapter Two
Friday 19: Chapter Three
Friday 26: Chapter Four[/size]

[size=4]Readings take place inside the Community Center from 1:00 PM until 5:00 PM.
Enter during that window to join Evelyn and the other villagers beside the fireplace. Evelyn introduces each story, reads the chapter, and shares a brief reflection before everyone heads home.
A morning reminder appears on reading days, and each gathering is also marked on the calendar.[/size]

[size=5][b]Sixteen Original Books[/b][/size]
[size=4]Evelyn’s collection contains sixteen complete stories divided between four genres.[/size]

[size=4][b][u]Fantasy[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]The Lantern of Briar Hollow
The Library Beneath the Lake
The Kingdom in the Teacup
The Bell at World’s End[/size]

[size=4][u][b]Horror[/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]The Candle in Room Seven
The Empty Chair
The Longest Friday
Footsteps in the Orchard[/size]

[size=4][u][b]Science Fiction[/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]Signal from Cinder Moon
The Time Farmer
The Memory Orchard
The Last Garden on Mars[/size]

[size=4][u][b]Detective Noir[/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]The Brass Canary
A Dead Man’s Alibi
The Black Tide Ledger
The Last Train to Ashport[/size]

[size=4]The detective stories follow private investigator Rafe Calder through four standalone cases in the rainy dark city of Greyhaven.[/size]
[size=4]
Each mystery presents its important clues before the final chapter, giving careful listeners a chance to solve the case before Rafe reveals the answer.[/size]

[size=5][b]The Fireside Reading Journal[/b][/size]
[size=4]Evelyn sends you a personal reading journal when the reading club begins.
The journal updates as you attend readings and provides a permanent record of your progress.
It records:[/size]

[size=4]-The current book and genre[/size]
[size=4]-A description of the current story[/size]
[size=4]-The next scheduled reading[/size]
[size=4]-How many chapters you have heard[/size]
[size=4]-Every completed book[/size]
[size=4]-Your progress through the sixteen-book collection[/size]

[size=5][b]Tea, Cookies, and Thoughtful Rewards[/b][/size]
[size=4]Every reading includes:[/size]

[size=4]-One cup of Earl Grey Tea that gives the player +85 Energy + 50 Health +1 Foraging and +1 Luck 
-One Cookie baked with love by Evelyn[/size]
[size=4]
After completing a book, Evelyn sends a personal letter reflecting on the story along with a small themed gift bundle.[/size]
[size=4]
Complete all four seasonal books in a reading year and Evelyn will send you the Tea Set to commemorate the afternoons you spent together.[/size]

[size=5][b]A Long-Term Reading Cycle[/b][/size]
[size=4]four-years of content with no repeated books.
Each reading year includes:[/size]

[size=4]One fantasy story
One horror story
One science-fiction story
One detective-noir story[/size]

[size=4]After all sixteen books have been read, the club continues indefinitely. Evelyn rotates between the four genres and selects another book from that genre’s collection each season.
You can continue attending Fireside Tales for as many years as you remain in the valley.[/size]

[size=5][b]Safe for Existing Saves[/b][/size]
[size=4]Evelyn’s Fireside Tales can be added to an existing save.
The mod checks the current season and week and begins at the appropriate point in the reading schedule. Installing after the first Friday of a season will not force you to begin at Chapter One or wait for a new year.
It's designed to make the town feel more lived in. If you join the club on Spring 9, you will have to read the journal to get caught up for Chapter 2 the following Friday.[/size]

[size=5][b]Music and Atmosphere[/b][/size]
[size=4]Each genre has its own event music:[/size]

[size=4]Lively medieval music for fantasy
Quiet, unsettling woodland music for horror
Dreamlike electronic music for science fiction
A smoky, jazzy theme for detective noir[/size]

[size=4][b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b]

Q: When does the reading club begin?
A: After the Community Center has been completed, Evelyn will send you a letter introducing Fireside Tales and enclosing your reading journal.

Q. When are the readings?
A: On the 5th, 12th, 19th, and 26th of every season. Enter the Community Center between 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM.

Q: Can I skip the event?
A: Yes only if you want to be a curmudgeon. 
 
Q: Can I install the mod in the middle of a season?
A: Yes. The mod aligns itself with the current week and begins with the next appropriate chapter.

Q: Will the stories eventually repeat?
A: Not during the first 4 years. After the complete four-year collection has been presented, Evelyn continues selecting books indefinitely.

Q: Do I need Stardew Valley Expanded?
A: No. The mod is designed for the vanilla game. Stardew Valley Expanded support is included for players who use it.

Q: Was this mod made with AI?
A: No, each story was written by me from my collection of stories I wrote for my kids, no AI was used for coding. [/size]


[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=4]This mod requires:[/size]

[size=4]-SMAPI 4.1.0 or later
-Content Patcher 2.8.0 or later
-BETAS 3.4.0 or later
-Parchment 1.5.0 or later ([/size][size=4]Parchment is required for the Fireside Reading Journal).[/size]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4]Install SMAPI.
Install Content Patcher, BETAS, and Parchment.
Download Evelyn’s Fireside Tales.
Drop it into your mods folder. [/size]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4]Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6
Compatible with existing saves
Includes support for Stardew Valley Expanded and Community Center Reimagined[/size]
